items.where: left of centre, over the entrance: square brick tower 4.4 m wide (t 1.8-6.2 m from the north-west end), rising ~6 m over the crenellated parapet to a pale stone band at ~23-24 m pierced with cross-shaped vents, a projecting cornice and a flared, stepped dark-stone cap with a finial (3DBAG ridge 27.0 m NAP)
items.how: tower(): brick box flush with the front (10 cm proud, so it never shares the facade plane), stone band with four cross vents a side, cornice, four tapering slate tiers and a finial
items.note: cap and band also on Commons 20529086, 20529090, 20529091, 20529092 (RCE, CC BY-SA 4.0)

items.where: tower front, high: round window with a white rosette in a stone ring, ~1.3 m across, centre ~20.8 m
items.how: stone ring, glass disc and four white bars crossing it (eight spokes); the rosette tracery is reduced to the spokes

items.where: tower front, top-floor level (~13.3-14.6 m): two narrow windows side by side
items.how: two glass slabs in brown frames with stone sills

items.where: whole front parapet: a row of ~22 grey stone merlons (0.5 m wide, ~0.9 m high, pointed tops, a round hole in each) on a stone coping at ~16.6-17.0 m, two left of the tower
items.how: parapet(): brick parapet slab, stone coping, merlons as pointed polygons with a dark square for the hole, 0.83 m pitch
items.note: also Commons 20529087 (merlons from the roof) and 20529088

items.where: both front corners at the parapet: a corbelled stone pinnacle carrying a merlon (~0.9 m wide, corbel at ~15 m)
items.how: stone corbel block, stone pier and a merlon top at each end

items.where: parapet band above the four window groups (~15.1-15.85 m): the letters A N D B, one per group, red on a red panel in a stone frame
items.how: stone frame, red-brown panel and pixel letters (nearbar letters) on each group axis

items.where: tower foot: a big round-headed arch of pale dressed stone (outer ~2.9 m wide, apex ~7.9 m) around the wooden front door at the top of the stair, "No" and "9" carved on the impost blocks
items.how: entrance(): stone arch band with impost blocks round a brown door slab; the No/9 carvings are too small and left out

items.where: in front of the arch: a straight stone stair of ~16 steps perpendicular to the front up to the door at ~3.2 m, between stone side walls with sloping copings ending in round stone pedestals at the pavement
items.how: stair(): stepped extrusion between two sloping stone side walls and two cylindrical pedestals with domed tops

items.where: tower front over the arch (~8.5-9.6 m): square stone tablet with the red ANDB monogram, an A in a ring
items.how: stone tablet, red ring and a red pixel A

items.where: four bays right of the tower, each a group of three brown-framed windows per storey under one long pale stone lintel: ground 0.75-2.65 m, first 4.0-6.85 m, second 8.0-10.45 m; groups 2.7 m wide on a 3.45 m pitch
items.how: windowGroup(): three framed panes with a transom, a stone lintel slab and a sill ledge per group and storey

items.where: top storey (13.3-14.5 m): groups of three small windows with pointed stone hoods carved with a cross, under a continuous stone band at ~14.75-15.0 m
items.how: three small framed windows per group, a pointed stone hood polygon over each, the full-width stone band

items.where: three tall ochre-painted downpipes: left of the tower, at its right edge and at the right end, ground to the parapet
decorative iron wall anchors between and over the window groups (~0.4 m tall), at ~7.4, ~11.6 and ~16 m
items.how: thin dark bars between the groups at 7.4 and 11.6 m

items.where: right end, ground floor: a plain wooden door under a stone lintel
items.how: brown door slab with a stone lintel

items.where: grey stone plinth along the front, ~0.45 m
stone bollards with iron rails along the pavement in front of the building

skip.note: they stand on the pavement line 5-7 m off the front, outside the BAG footprint and the model; street furniture, not part of the building

items.where: rear of the main block: groups of three tall windows per storey in dark brick
items.how: rear(): dark brick facing panel and the front storey grid of three-window groups without stone lintels

items.where: roof behind the tower (seen from the roof, Commons 20529089): a pitched glass roof light over the hall
items.how: 3DBAG roof planes 71 and 72 (17.1-18.9 m) drawn in roof glass

walls.note: No panorama. Commons 20529083 and 20529084 (RCE 2007, CC BY-SA 4.0) show the rear of the main block: dark grey-brown brick, groups of three tall leaded windows with dark brick surrounds over a storey of groups of three smaller windows and a top storey of small windows, plain parapet. Which stretch of the rear they show is not pinned, so the builder applies that pattern to the whole rear (inferred).
No panorama, no photo: a short side wall towards the low rear annex; drawn as plain brick (inferred).
